# FO - Warning error displayed when customizated product added to cart  

This error is displayed on the top of the page when a customized product is added to cart : 

**Warning: Undefined array key "isRewritable" in /Users/iUstaoglu/Sites/localhost/mercredi9.0.0/src/Adapter/Presenter/AbstractLazyArray.php on line 401**

![Capture d’écran 2024-09-13 à 15 05 23](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/da695edd-70d6-44ab-a94b-92f9f8baa66b)


https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a8fc03da-181a-475b-bde5-0d0b4192aac3

**Remark : 
The error is no more displayed when the product is deleted from the cart.**

## Attendu
No error should be displayed

## Étapes
1. Go to BO
2. Enable the debug mode
3. Go on the FO 
4. Search for a customizable product
5. Click on the product
6. Type a text in the field 'Product customization'
7. Click on the CTA 'Save customization'
8. Click on the CTA 'Add to cart'
9. Ctrl + shift + r
